svg.text: 7 interaction states — animation timing & mobile adaptation

g.text: modal.isOpen = false · backdrop hidden · no focus trap
trigger at normal flow · modal unmounted
OPEN — fully visible · focus trapped · scroll locked
STICKY HEADER — shadow appears on scroll
SCROLL LOCK FOOTER — shadow above footer
scroll-lock: footer stays fixed · shadow indicates more content above
MOBILE SHEET — bottom drawer · top corners rounded
